Users are created, edited and removed only in Master Settings. They are stored in the database, so the same login works on every device and in every project they have been given. This list is a read-only view of who can reach this project.

Data Backup

All data is saved automatically in this browser on this computer. Each project has its own backup file — the file is named after the project and carries everything that project owns: every day, the BOQ and Work Plan, work orders and bills, the store, procurement, site documents, drawings, RFIs, COS letters, site instructions, cylinder tests, users and photographs. Export one regularly (e.g. weekly) to keep your records safe or to move them to another computer. To restore, use the ⬆ Import Data button at the top (your password required) — a backup can only be loaded back into the project it was taken from, so another project’s file can never overwrite this one by mistake.

Sharing with another person? Use 📤 Save shareable App — it creates an HTML file with all current users, BOQ and records built in, so when they open it nothing is missing. (A plain copy of this file opens empty on their computer, because data lives in the browser, not in the file.)
